verses.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾ ਵਡਾ ਅਖਾਇਦਾ ਨਾਭਿ ਕਵਲ ਦੀ ਨਾਲਿ ਸਮਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: brahamaa vaddaa akhaidhaa naabh kaval dhee naal samaanaa|

en.bdb: Calling himself great, Brahma entered into the naval lotus (Of Visnu to know its end).

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਵਾ ਗਵਣੁ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੁਗ ਓੜਕ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੋਆ ਹੈਰਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: aavaa gavan anek jug oRak vich hoaa hairaanaa|

en.bdb: For many ages he wandered in the cycle of transmigration and ultimately become dumbfounded.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓੜਕੁ ਕੀਤੁਸੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪ ਗਣਾਇਐ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: oRak keetus aapanaa aap ganaiaai bharam bhulaanaa|

en.bdb: He left no stone unturned but remained misguided in his own so-called greatness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਵਖਾਣਦਾ ਚਤੁਰਮੁਖੀ ਹੋਇ ਖਰਾ ਸਿਆਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaare bedh vakhaanadhaa chaturamukhee hoi kharaa siaanaa|

en.bdb: He becoming four-headed and wise would recite the four Vedas.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਕਾਂ ਨੋ ਸਮਝਾਇਂਦਾ ਵੇਖਿ ਸੁਰਸਤੀ ਰੂਪ ਲੋਭਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: lokaa(n) no samajhai(n)dhaa vekh surasatee roop lobhaanaa|

en.bdb: He would make people understand many things but seeing the beauty of his own daughter, Sarasvati, became enamoured.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਬੇਦ ਗਵਾਇ ਕੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਗਰੂਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ।
verses.translit_en: chaare bedh gavai kai garab garooree kar pachhutaanaa|

en.bdb: He made his knowledge of the four Vedas futile. Proud as he became, he had to repent eventually.
In fact the Lord is ineffable; in Vedas also He is also described as neti neti, (not this, not this).
